brief_title: Efficacy and Safety of HRS-7535 Tablets in T2DM Subjects Poorly Controlled With Metformin and SGLT2i.
official_title: A Multicenter, Randomized, Double-blinded, Placebo-controlled, Parallel-group Phase ⅡStudy to Evaluate the Efficacy and Safety of HRS-7535 in T2DM Subjects Poorly Controlled With Metformin and SGLT2i.

primary_outcomes.measure: Change in HbA1c from baseline at Week 16

brief_summary: 2 weeks screening period, 3 weeks run-in period, 16 weeks double-blind treatment period, to evaluate the Safety and Efficacy of HRS-7535 in Subjects with Type 2 Diabetes who have Inadequate Glycemic Control on Metformin and SGLT2i.

sites.facility: The Sun Yat-sen Memorial Hospital of Sun Yat-sen University

inclusion.text: Male or female subjects, 18-75 years of age at the time of signing informed consent;
Have T2DM (based on the 2020 Chinese Diabetes Society [CDS] diagnostic criteria)
FPG≤15 mmol/L at the screening visit;
Have been treated with an SGLT2i with metformin, for at least 8 weeks;
At screening and random visit, 20.0 ≤BMI≤ 35.0 kg/m2;
Able and willing to provide a written informed consent

exclusion.text: History of acute cardiovascular and cerebrovascular diseases within 6 months prior to screening;
Any organ-system malignancies developed within 5 years except for cured local basal cell cancer of the skin and in-situ cancer of the cervix;
history of blood donation or blood loss in the 3 months before screening, or blood transfusion in the 2 months before screening;
Surgery is planned during the trial;
Female who is pregnant, breast-feeding or intends to become pregnant or is of childbearing potential and not using an adequate contraceptive method;
